oneLiner: 原子 = 居于中心的原子核（质子 + 中子）+ 核外分层运动的电子。
oneLinerEn: An atom = a central nucleus (protons + neutrons) ringed by electrons in shells.
detail: 质子带正电、电子带负电、中子不带电；中性原子中质子数 = 原子序数 = 核外电子数，质量数 = 质子数 + 中子数。
detailEn: Protons are +, electrons −, neutrons 0; in a neutral atom protons = atomic number = electrons, and mass number = protons + neutrons.

oneLiner: 电子按能级分层排布，各层最多容纳 2n² 个；最外层不超过 8 个。
oneLinerEn: Electrons fill shells by energy, each holding at most 2n², with no more than 8 in the outermost shell.
detail: 前 20 号元素常按 2·8·8 规律排布；最外层电子数决定元素的化学性质与化合价。
detailEn: Elements 1–20 roughly follow 2·8·8; the outermost count sets chemical behavior and valence.

oneLiner: 活泼金属把电子交给活泼非金属，形成阴阳离子，靠静电作用结合。
oneLinerEn: A metal transfers electrons to a nonmetal; the resulting ions attract electrostatically.
detail: 如 NaCl：Na 失 1 电子成 Na⁺，Cl 得 1 电子成 Cl⁻；离子键无方向性，熔沸点高、固态不导电、熔融或溶于水导电。
detailEn: In NaCl, Na loses one electron (Na⁺) and Cl gains it (Cl⁻); ionic solids have high melting points and conduct when molten or dissolved.

oneLiner: 两原子共用电子对而成键，多见于非金属之间。
oneLinerEn: Atoms share electron pairs; common between nonmetals.
detail: 如 H₂、H₂O、CO₂；共用一对为单键、两对为双键、三对为三键；分极性键（H–Cl）与非极性键（H–H）。
detailEn: E.g. H₂, H₂O, CO₂; one/two/three shared pairs give single/double/triple bonds; polar (H–Cl) vs nonpolar (H–H).

oneLiner: 价层电子对相互排斥，使分子采取排斥最小的空间排布。
oneLinerEn: Valence electron pairs repel, so molecules adopt the arrangement of least repulsion.
detail: CO₂ 直线形（180°）、H₂O 为 V 形（约 105°）、CH₄ 为正四面体（109.5°）、NH₃ 为三角锥形。构型影响分子极性与性质。
detailEn: CO₂ is linear (180°), H₂O bent (~105°), CH₄ tetrahedral (109.5°), NH₃ trigonal pyramidal; shape drives polarity and properties.

oneLiner: 分子间存在比化学键弱得多的作用力；含 H–F/O/N 时形成氢键。
oneLinerEn: Weak forces act between molecules; H bonded to F/O/N forms hydrogen bonds.
detail: 范德华力普遍存在；氢键比范德华力强，使水、HF、NH₃ 沸点反常偏高，也维系 DNA 双螺旋与蛋白质结构。
detailEn: Van der Waals forces are universal; stronger H-bonds raise the boiling points of water, HF and NH₃ and hold DNA and protein structures.

oneLiner: 微粒按一定方式有序排列成晶体，按结合微粒与作用分为四类。
oneLinerEn: Particles ordered into crystals, grouped by what holds them together.
detail: 离子晶体（NaCl）由离子键结合、熔沸点较高；原子晶体（金刚石、SiO₂）共价键成网、极硬极高熔；分子晶体（干冰、冰）靠分子间作用力、熔沸点低；金属晶体由金属键结合、导电导热延展好。
detailEn: Ionic (NaCl, via ionic bonds), covalent-network (diamond, SiO₂, very hard and refractory), molecular (dry ice, ice, low melting) and metallic (metal bonding, conductive and malleable).
